lyrics:
[00:00.400] I think once I took my first Vicodin, it was just like, this feeling of "Ah"
[00:05.640] You know, like everything was not only mellow, but didn't feel any pain
[00:10.620] It just didn't–, it just kind of numbed things
[00:12.870] I don't know at what point exactly it started to be a problem
[00:16.910] I just remember liking it more and more
[00:20.230] People try to tell me that I had a problem
[00:22.620] I would say, "Get that fucking person out of here, I can't believe they said that shit to me, they know nothing about my fucking life, are they out of their fucking mind?"
[00:28.930] I'm not out there shooting heroin, I'm not out there fucking, you know, putting coke up my nose, I'm not smoking crack
[00:34.910] You're struggling with the argument of "Do you have a problem, or do you not have a problem? Can you control it, or can you not?"
[00:41.540] And I literally thought I could control it
[00:43.680] You're taking things that people are giving you that, you don't even know what the fuck they are
[00:48.400] They look like a pill, and they look– they're shaped like something that you take, so you take it, you know?
[00:56.080] Xanax, Valium, tomato-tomato
[00:58.980] You know what I mean? It's th-the same thing, it's all in the same family, fuck it, take it
[01:03.050] Had I had gotten to the hospital about two hours later, I would've died
[01:07.540] My organs were shutting down, my liver, kidneys, everything
[01:10.690] They were gonna have to put me on dialysis, they didn't think I was gonna make it
[01:13.540] My bottom was gonna be death, within a month, I had relapsed
[01:18.410] And shot right back up to the same amount of pills that I was taking
[01:21.990] I remember just walking around my house and thinking every single day, like, "I'm gonna fucking die", like, I'm-I'm looking at my kids, and I need to be here for this
[01:31.150] Coming off of everything, I literally was up 24 hours a day for three weeks straight
[01:36.320] And I mean not sleeping, not even nodding off for a fucking minute
[01:42.120] Like, I was literally just up, like, looking at the TV
[01:46.640] I had to regain motor skills, I had to regain talking skills
[01:50.580] It's been a-a learning process, like, it's been, I'm growing
[01:54.640] I just couldn't believe that anybody could ever be naturally happy, or naturally function, or be just enjoying life in general, without being on something
[02:03.480] So, I would say that t-to anybody that i-it does get better, you know? It just– it does
[02:10.040]
title: Eminem Speaks (feat. Eminem)
author: Juice WRLD
